object.name: evi_overdrive_env
object.digest: High quality anti-aliased passive tanh-like input/output saturation
object.description: The simplest of the evieve 'overdrive' objects, a memoryless nonlinear approximation with high quality antiderivative and oversampled processing. Can handle high gain input and remains well anti-aliased.

outlets.name: buzzy-tanh(x)
outlets.digestauto: Out - anti-aliased for your audio not for Maths

attributes.name: aa
attributes.description: The 'aa' ('Anti-Aliasing) method used. 0=Adaa1, 1=Adaa1 2x oversampled, 2=Adaa1 4x oversampled, 3=Adaa2 (default), 4=Adaa2 2x oversampled, 5=Adaa2 4x oversampled. 0..5 does not necessarily mean increasing in quality, it really depends on your audio input material. Experimentation is encouraged.

attributes.name: hfcompensate
attributes.description: The object provides a high frequency compensation 'decorelation' filter on its output for restoring the reduced high frequency response that can occur with this type of anti-aliasing, especially when utilising the oversampling options (as opposed to just using pure 'adaa'). Experiment with turning this on to improve high frequencies (default on).
